Launch content-managed websites without rebuilding the foundation.

pages.title: About Us
pages.excerpt: WTS CMS is a reusable content platform by Webskitters Technology Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
pages.content:
About the platform

A practical CMS starter for smaller Webskitters builds.

WTS CMS packages the repeatable pieces every content-managed website needs: admin management, public rendering, SEO controls, publishing, media, redirects, and role based access.

Why it exists

Many small and mid-sized website projects need strong fundamentals but do not need a heavyweight enterprise stack. WTS CMS keeps the architecture straightforward so teams can customize quickly and ship confidently.

  1. Reusable foundation. Start from a tested monorepo with API, admin, frontend, shared utilities, and Podman local development.
  2. Content-first delivery. Editors can manage pages, blogs, menus, redirects, settings, SEO metadata, and media.
  3. Production-minded controls. Security middleware, validation, RBAC, audit logs, health checks, and structured logging are already in place.

blogs.title: Welcome to WTS CMS
blogs.excerpt: A guided tour of the Webskitters-powered CMS starter and the problems it solves.
blogs.content:
Platform context

A guided tour of the Webskitters-powered CMS starter and the problems it solves. WTS CMS keeps the core stack simple: Express, MongoDB, Next.js, strict TypeScript, and a reusable admin experience.

For Webskitters teams, this means faster project starts, fewer repeated setup decisions, and a consistent pattern for SEO, security, media, redirects, and roles.

Webskitters workflow

The recommended workflow is to model the content first, assign the right RBAC permissions, prepare SEO metadata, review public rendering, and then publish with confidence.

  • Keep URLs lowercase, descriptive, and redirect-safe.
  • Write one editable H1 and use H2/H3 sections in content.
  • Add image alt text and schema when the page deserves rich search context.

snapshot.content:
Platform context

Use WTS CMS redirects to protect rankings when published URLs change. WTS CMS keeps the core stack simple: Express, MongoDB, Next.js, strict TypeScript, and a reusable admin experience.

For Webskitters teams, this means faster project starts, fewer repeated setup decisions, and a consistent pattern for SEO, security, media, redirects, and roles.

Webskitters workflow

The recommended workflow is to model the content first, assign the right RBAC permissions, prepare SEO metadata, review public rendering, and then publish with confidence.

  • Keep URLs lowercase, descriptive, and redirect-safe.
  • Write one editable H1 and use H2/H3 sections in content.
  • Add image alt text and schema when the page deserves rich search context.
